note: What a client sends to tell a server what it wants a unit to do. The path it carries is what the client would take; where the unit actually goes is whatever the server answers with. The header names the sender's champion.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What the order is.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the player clicked, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: targetY
fields.note: The height there.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Along the other ground axis.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit clicked, or zero for the ground.

fields.name: movement

bits.name: unusedLow
bits.note: Clear: a client sends no teleport token.

bits.name: pointCount
bits.note: How many points the path has, from 1 to 127. A group whose entry gives 0 ends there.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: The unit the path is for. Where a client does not hold it, the movements after it in the group go wrong too; a server sends only units the client holds.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: Whether each coordinate of the points after the first is a step from the point before it.

fields.name: firstX
fields.note: The first point, along one ground axis, in the map's path coordinates.

fields.name: firstZ
fields.note: Along the other ground axis.

fields.name: steps
xStep
fields.note: A step from the point before, along one axis.

fields.name: xWhole
fields.note: The coordinate afresh.

fields.name: zStep
fields.note: A step along the other axis.

fields.name: zWhole
fields.note: The coordinate afresh.
Every point after the first.
The path the client worked out for its champion.

revisions.note: What a client sends as its player orders the champion somewhere. The header names the champion.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: What is being asked for.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the order points, along one ground axis. Carried in world units rather than in the units a path uses.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where the order points, along the other.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The network object the order is aimed at, or zero where it is aimed at open ground.
